# Polygon SQLite Baseline

Canonical baseline polygon stored as a SQLite spatial dataset using the same coordinates as the GeoJSON happy-path polygon.

|---|---|
| Case ID | `polygon_sqlite_baseline` |
| Category | vector |

## What this case checks

Provide a canonical polygon encoded in SQLite so database-backed vector loading can be compared against flat-file formats.
